newsitem.title: ITALY: Eni unit signs methane gas deal with Russia.
newsitem.headline: Eni unit signs methane gas deal with Russia.

text.p: Snam, the natural gas unit of Italian energy giant Eni, said on Friday it had signed a deal with RAO Gazprom to export methane gas from Russia.
It said Snam would start bringing the gas into Italy in the year 2000 and would eventually receive eight billion cubic metres of methane a year from Russia.
Snam did not give a value for the contract.
In 1995 Italy imported 25 percent of its methane from Russia. That figure would rise to around 33 percent by 2010, Snam said.

"This deal allows Italy to guarantee the long-term supply of energy needed for economic development and allows Russia to continue with its policy of tapping gas reserves in difficult parts of Siberia," the company statement said. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
